home.heading: Dragon Ecosystem
home.intro: Compete in tournaments, follow your games, and build your team. One platform for the whole scene.
home.pillarCompeteBody: Join tournaments, climb brackets, and track standings across your games.
home.pillarTeamBody: Create or join a roster, manage invitations, and play together.
home.pillarWalletBody: Hold Dragon Coin, register for events, and collect prize entitlements.
home.ctaBody: Create an account and enter your first tournament today.
home.featuredEmpty: Nothing published here yet. Check back soon.
home.apiUnavailable: The API service did not respond. Refresh the page or try again shortly.

auth.heading: Sign in
auth.intro: Enter your mobile number and we will send you a one-time code.
auth.codeSent: If the number is valid, a code has been sent.

code.label: One-time code
code.hint: You can request a new code after {seconds} seconds.

account.heading: Account
account.emptyMessage: No account modules are enabled yet. Profiles, teams, and registrations arrive in later delivery slices.
account.completeProfile: Complete your profile to take part in tournaments.
account.signedOutMessage: Sign in to see your account.

profile.heading: Profile
profile.intro: Your public identity and account preferences.

avatar.label: Avatar
avatar.hint: A square image works best; shown on your profile and in the header.

birthDate.label: Date of birth
birthDate.hint: You must be at least 13 years old to use the platform.

visibility.note: Your profile is private by default. Only your username and display name become public.

security.heading: Security
security.intro: Review where you are signed in and what happened on your account.

admin.heading: Administration
admin.emptyMessage: No administration modules are enabled yet. Available areas will appear here based on your permissions.
admin.noAreas: You have no administration areas enabled.

community.title: Community moderation
community.intro: Recent community posts, including removed ones. A removed post keeps its body so the case stays reviewable.
community.appealsGate: Appeals are not available yet. A removal cannot be challenged in the product until the appeal workflow is approved.

audit.heading: Audit log
audit.caption: Immutable audit events
audit.exportReasonPrompt: Enter a reason for the export (required):

media.heading: Media library
media.intro: Review uploaded assets, correct their alternative text, publish staged files, and remove what nothing uses.
media.confirmDelete: Delete this asset? Anything still pointing at it will be refused by the server.

config.heading: Configuration
config.intro: Versioned settings. Finance, security, and payout keys are high-risk and need a second operator to approve them.
config.highRiskNote: A high-risk key is stored as a proposal until a different operator approves it. Everything else takes effect immediately.
config.awaitingApproval: Proposed. It needs approval from a different operator.

notifications.heading: Notifications
notifications.intro: Message templates and the delivery log. Recipients are masked and never shown in full.

finance.heading: Finance
finance.intro: Dragon Coin holds and cash prize entitlements. Every action is recorded with a reason.
finance.evidencePrompt: Settlement evidence (reference from the payment record):
finance.dualControlNote: Marking an entitlement paid and force-releasing a hold both require the finance-approver permission, which your account does not hold. You can capture holds, approve entitlements, and mark them failed.

support.heading: Support
support.intro: The support case queue and account-recovery triage.
support.noCases: No support cases match this filter.
support.recoveryNote: Triage only: a request can be recorded as reviewed or rejected. Restoring access is not available from this screen by design.

ops.heading: Operations
ops.intro: Alerts, background job runs, and the current metrics snapshot.

organizer.heading: Organizer workspace
organizer.intro: Your events, what is waiting on you, and a direct route into each one.
organizer.empty: You have not created any tournaments yet.

designSystem.heading: Design system
designSystem.intro: Shared components, states, and tokens used across the platform. This page is a developer reference and is not indexed.
